text:
Alexis Lafrenière was the first overall pick in 2020, and for years the question was when the scoring would catch up. A quarter into this season, Sports Illustrated ran the headline "Alexis Lafreniere Looks Like a Star Player for NY Rangers a Quarter Into the Season," and the numbers mostly agree: 10 goals and 22 points in 22 games.

How much is real? The chances are. His 1.14 expected goals per 60 minutes (expected goals measure the quality of his looks) is well above last season's 0.94. The finishing is running hot: 20.8% shooting against a range of 12.4 to 17 that our numbers expect over time. And the last ten games were quieter, two goals and eight points, which is about what his chances earned.

Evolving-Hockey had him worth 2.6 wins above replacement last season, 29th among forwards, with strong defensive impact against tough competition. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says 57% of his shots come off the rush, so watch the first seconds after a Rangers turnover. That is when he is most dangerous.
headline: Lafrenière looks like the star he was drafted to be
